applicability: 20-year statutory utility-patent-term baseline expiration date from a declared filing date, checked against a claimed expiration
assumptions: a standard 20-year utility patent term from the earliest claimed filing date
no Patent Term Adjustment, Patent Term Extension, or terminal disclaimer applied
uncertainty: Standard, well-established US statutory rule (35 U.S.C. 154(a)(2)); hand-verified before use (filing 2010-05-15 + 20y -> 2030-05-15).
limits_policy: A claimed expiration deviating from the 20-year baseline is flagged for PTA/PTE/terminal-disclaimer reconciliation rather than accepted or rejected outright.
